overview: The Medford Historical District Commission reviewed insurance considerations for properties in historic districts, received an update on the Medford Square rezoning effort, and approved its previous meeting minutes.

items.title: Insurance and historic properties discussion
items.summary: The commission postponed an invited guest's presentation due to a family emergency and held a preliminary discussion on insurance replacement costs, code coverage, and bonding challenges for designated historic properties.

items.title: Medford Square rezoning update
items.summary: Staff reported that a broad commercial historic district for Medford Square is no longer an immediate priority, with interest shifting toward creating an institutional historic district encompassing CPA-funded buildings and churches.

items.title: Approval of minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the February meeting minutes as amended.

items.title: Institutional district religious symbol considerations
items.summary: Commissioners discussed how creating an institutional historic district might intersect with religious iconography, alterations, and potential changes in property ownership.
